$comment: Expected model set for the Codex half of the MODEL REGISTRY guard (completion plan P3.8, row 39): the models the
supported Codex CLI itself lists in its model picker, as Claude's half uses the Claude Code model configuration
article (resources/claude-code-model-configuration.json).
Source: the models catalogue bundled in the Codex CLI binary (codex-rs models.json), read from the binary's bytes,
never by running it; every model whose visibility is "list", in the catalogue's priority order, with its
display_name. `codex debug models` renders the same catalogue. Hidden entries (visibility "hide": migrated,
internal or review-only models) are not offered and are not listed here.
Since aicc_planning#362 (2.1.3-beta.14) the app's Codex picker offers the installed Codex's own list, read from
it (`codex debug models --bundled`), each model with its own levels; resources/model-registry.json only adds
prices or corrections, and is offered alone when no list can be read. It still carries every id here as a
pickable model of the codex family, with that model's supported_reasoning_levels as its `efforts`
(tests/unit/codex-model-registry.test.ts pins it), so that fallback offers these models; a model a later Codex
adds needs no row. Read by src/main/sentinel/sentinel-models.ts, which, when no list was read, reports a Codex
model the registry offers that this list no longer names. Sentinel reports a stale snapshot after 90 days.
The list is the union over the supported CLI versions (cliVersions): a model stays while a supported version lists it.
gpt-5.2 is listed by 0.153.4 only; 0.155.1 no longer lists it (it still accepts `-m gpt-5.2` at launch). It is kept
while 0.153.4 is supported; whether to drop it is the owner's call (completion plan section 10). P3.9's live read
(`codex debug models`, no sign-in, no network) resolves the list per installed version.
A model's own cliVersions names the supported versions that list it, when not every one does.
0.156.1 (CODEX_MAX_TESTED_VERSION) was added on 2026-10-12 from the same file, codex-rs/models-manager/models.json,
at the rust-v0.156.1 release tag (the catalogue built into that binary). Read the same way that day, the
rust-v0.153.4 and rust-v0.155.1 tags list exactly the models this file gives for them. gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna
are listed from 0.156.1 on.
0.157.1 (CODEX_MAX_TESTED_VERSION from 2.1.3-beta.11) was added on 2026-11-19 the same way, from the rust-v0.157.1
tag: the same seven models as 0.156.1, with the same labels, levels and order. The real 0.157.1 CLI listed the same
seven ids on Windows, macOS and Linux in CI run 44530382595 (`codex debug models --bundled`). fetchedAt stays the
date the 0.153.4 and 0.155.1 lists were read.
0.170.0 (CODEX_MAX_TESTED_VERSION from 2.1.3-beta.11, aicc_planning#347) was added on 2026-11-19 the same way, from
the rust-v0.170.0 tag: eleven models, the seven of 0.157.1 with the same labels and levels, after four new ones it
lists first (gpt-6.2-sol, gpt-6.2-astra, gpt-6.1-terra, gpt-6.1-sol; every level up to ultra; "GPT-6.1 Terra" is
spelled with a space, as Codex spells it). The real 0.170.0 CLI listed the same eleven ids, in that order, on
Windows, macOS and Linux in CI run 44547276658.
0.171.0 (CODEX_MAX_TESTED_VERSION from 2.1.3-beta.11) was added on 2026-11-20 from the real CLI: it listed the same
eleven ids as 0.170.0, in the same order, on Windows, macOS and Linux in CI run 44688602365
(`codex debug models --bundled`), all covered by the registry. Its labels and levels were not read from its tag;
the entries keep 0.170.0's.
0.172.0 (CODEX_MAX_TESTED_VERSION from 2.1.3-beta.19, aicc_planning#436) was added on 2026-11-26 from the real
CLI: it listed the same eleven ids as 0.171.0, in the same order, on Windows, macOS and Linux in CI run
45756034358 (`codex debug models --bundled`), all covered by the registry. Its labels and levels were not read from
its tag; the entries keep 0.170.0's.
Also read by the release gate (scripts/release-gate.mjs, check 3): an empty or unreadable list, a listed id a
Claude model has, or a Codex id the registry lists twice refuses the cut; a listed id with no registry row does not.
source: the model catalogue bundled with the Codex CLI
